description: License policy for QuickEx runtime, build and tooling dependencies. Denied licenses impose copyleft, field-of-use or non-commercial obligations that are incompatible with a permissively licensed, custody-neutral client. Review licenses are permitted only with a recorded exception.

exceptions.justification: Weak (file-level) copyleft. Accepted for build and test tooling that is not redistributed: axe-core (accessibility testing), lightningcss and its platform binaries (CSS build). Obligations are confined to the files carrying the licence, which are not part of any shipped QuickEx bundle.
Attribution-only, non-copyleft. Accepted for caniuse-lite, a build-time browser-compat data file consumed by the bundler and not redistributed as QuickEx source.

Weak copyleft on a prebuilt native binary. Accepted for @img/sharp-libvips-*, the libvips distribution shipped as a prebuilt image-processing binary used only for local asset resizing. It is dynamically linked, replaceable, and not modified in-tree; the corresponding source is available from libvips upstream per the licence.

busboy 1.6.0 publishes no SPDX `license` field; its LICENSE file and repository are MIT. Recorded so the gate reports the packaging gap instead of blocking the build. Re-check on the next major upgrade.
streamsearch 1.1.0 publishes no SPDX `license` field; its LICENSE file and repository are MIT. Transitive dependency of busboy. Re-check on the next major upgrade.
